questions_and_answers.question_text: Zài Guǎngzhōu Jiāoyìhuìshang jiù zuò chūkǒude mǎimai ma?

answers.answer_text: Do they only do export business at the Guǎngzhōu Trade Fair?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bù jiù shi chūkǒu, yě yǒu hěn duō rén zài nàr tán jìnkǒu màoyì.

answers.answer_text: Not just export business. Many people also do import trade there.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèi jǐge jīngjì tèqū yuè lái yuè fánróng le.

answers.answer_text: These special economic zones are getting more and more prosperous.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì a! Jìnchūkǒu màoyì, jiāgōng gōngyè yuè gǎo yuè duō le.

answers.answer_text: Yes! Import-export trade and the processing industry are on the upswing.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Guǎngjiāohuìshangde dōngxi jiàqian zěnmeyàng?

answers.answer_text: How are the prices at the Guǎngzhōu Trade Fair?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Jiàqian dōu hái bú cuò, wàiguó shāngren hěn shǎo yǒu kōngshǒu huíqùde.

answers.answer_text: The prices are pretty good. It's very seldom that a foreign businessman goes home empty-handed.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Jīngjì tèqūde Zhōngguó gōngren shōurù bǐjiào gāo, nà huì bu huì chūxiàn yíge xīnde jiējí ne?

answers.answer_text: Since the income of Chinese workers in the special economic zones is higher, is it possible a new class will appear?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Méiyou nàme yánzhòng! Gèjí zhèngfǔ huì àn zhèngcè bànde.

answers.answer_text: It's not that serious! Every level of the government will go according to policy.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhōngguó zhèngfǔ shì bu shì xiànzhì xiāofèipǐnde jìnkǒu?

answers.answer_text: Does the Chinese government restrict consumer-good imports?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Dāi huǐr wǒ gěi nín ná yífènr cáiliào, nín yí kàn jiù qīngchu le.

answers.answer_text: I'll bring you some materials in a while. As soon as you read them you'll know the answer.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zài yíge gōngchǎngli, gōngzuò xiàolǜ gāode gōngren cái néng tígāo gōngzī, duì ba?

answers.answer_text: In a factory only workers with high efficiency can get a pay raise, right?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Duì a! Duō láo duō dé ma!

answers.answer_text: Right! More pay for more work, you know!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Lǎo Zhāng, jīntian kāi shénme huānsònghuì?

answers.answer_text: Lǎo Zhāng, what's the farewell meeting for today?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Huānsòng Ōuzhōude lǜshī dàibiǎotuán.

answers.answer_text: We're sending off the European delegation of lawyers.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Yǒule Zhōng-Měi hǎiyùn tiáoyuē yǐhòu, yánhǎi yídài jiù gèng rènao le.

answers.answer_text: Since the Sino-American sea transportation treaty, the coastal region has become even busier.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì a, kànqilai yǐhòude shínián, zhèi jǐge dà hǎigǎng huì yǒu dà guīmóde fāzhǎn.

answers.answer_text: Yes. It looks as if these large ports will experience tremendous growth in the next decade.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ tīngdào xiāoxi le meiyou? Jīntian wǎnshang yǒu hěn zhòngyàode rén lái.

answers.answer_text: Have you heard the news? Some very important people are coming tonight.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Jīntiānde wǎnhuì yídìng hěn yǒu yìsi, qiānwàn bié wǎn le.

answers.answer_text: Tonight's party is sure to be interesting. You mustn't be late!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ yào cānguān jiàoxué shèbèi.

answers.answer_text: I want to see the educational equipment.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Jiàoxué shèbèi dōu jízhōng zài zhèige dàtīngli le, huānyíng cānguān.

answers.answer_text: The educational equipment is all together in this large hall. You're welcome to see it.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhōng-Měi liǎngguó wèile zài gèfāngmiàn jìnxíng hézuò dìnghǎole bù shǎo jìhua.

answers.answer_text: China and America have made a lot of plans to cooperate in various fields.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ǹg. Gāng yùn dào Fújiànde zhèixiē shèbèi jiù shi nèixiē jìhuàde yíbùfen.

answers.answer_text: Mm. The equipment which was just shipped to Fújiàn is a part of those plans.
